items.title: ‘These are really tough times’: House Republicans confront voter fury over Trump’s Washington in final midterm stretch
items.brief: GOP operatives conducting a focus group in a traditionally red Midwestern state this month were taken aback by what they heard from their own party’s voters.

items.title: Deadly fire breaks out after ‘serious incident’ at Canada military base
items.brief: A major fire caused deaths and injuries at one of Canada’s busiest military bases on Saturday, sparked by an unspecified “serious incident,” with authorities still working to contain the blaze.

items.title: Abdul El-Sayed disavows Muslim Brotherhood and criticizes implications that he has ‘dual loyalty’
items.brief: Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed on Saturday disavowed the Muslim Brotherhood, an Islamist political movement, during a heated exchange at a town hall.

items.title: Buildings torched and over 1,000 detained after half a million protesters sweep France
items.brief: Riots broke out across major French cities on Saturday night as unrest spread beyond the capital, with government buildings torched and more than 1,000 people detained by police.

items.title: Trump waives Russia-related sanctions before they kick in, prompting backlash from Ukraine and US lawmakers
items.brief: US President Donald Trump has waived a further slate of sanctions related to Russian fossil fuel sales, sparking a bipartisan backlash days before they were to take effect under a bill he signed into law last month.
